examples.explanation: The value 3 at index 2 is larger than 2 and 1.
Either index 1 (value 2 beats 1 and 1) or index 5 (value 6 beats 5 and 4) is accepted; one of them is 5.
A lone element has no neighbours to beat.

hints: A peak can be found with binary search: if nums[mid] is smaller than its right neighbour, a peak must lie to the right.
Otherwise a peak lies at mid or to its left.
The judge accepts any valid peak index, so there is no need to find a specific one.
title: 315. Find Peak Element
